explanation.headline: FDA's records trace our supply to a plant classified OAI 523 days after the shortage posting

sentences.text: Cefotetan has been on FDA's shortage list since 2014-08-14 and remains listed as of 2026-10-21, a span of 146 months.
The product used across Corvale sites carries NDC 63323038510 labeled by Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC and is manufactured at ACS DOBFAR SPA (FEI 3006028606) in Italy.
FDA inspected that plant on 2016-01-19 and classified it OAI with 14 observations on laboratory controls and documentation, 523 days after the shortage was first posted.
A Warning Letter followed on 2017-01-13 for the same facility.
Subsequent inspections in 2017, 2018, 2022, and 2024 returned VAI classifications.
An alternate manufacturer, PAI Holdings, LLC dba PAI Pharma (NDC 00121097610), is not on FDA's shortage list today.

The highest-ranked action is to transfer 11 vials of the 1 g/10 mL presentation from Corvale Lakeside, which holds 27 days on hand, to Corvale East, which holds 9.5 days and would reach 12 days after the move.
